## Context / Problem
Client projects that supply their own criteria (`.rebar/criteria_routing.json`) must be able to run the same eval harnesses rebar uses for its core evals: plan replay, fixture mining, and provider parity. Today the harnesses hard-code repository paths under `docs/experiments/` and write into whatever checkout they are run from, the `evals` extra is unregistered, and 13 MB of executable research artefacts live under `docs/`. The operator ruled on 2026-09-06 that the hard-coded paths are a bug and the harnesses must be exposed to clients. Cites re-verified on origin/main f147e08242f.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `rebar.llm.config.evals_corpus_root()` is the only place the replay cache, replay output, ledger, and project eval-spec roots are resolved: with no config it returns `<repo_root>/.rebar/evals`; with this repo's `rebar.toml` it returns `<repo_root>/docs/experiments` until the corpus move lands. `git grep -n 'docs/experiments' -- src/rebar/llm/evals` returns exactly one line, the `plan_replay/corpus.py:5` docstring. Checked by `tests/unit/evals/test_evals_corpus_root.py` (four precedence cases plus `test_no_hard_coded_roots`) and by `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_corpus.py` passing unchanged. Delivered by the config-seam story.
- [x] The research corpus (the `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/` tree) is moved to a top-level `evals/` directory, `rebar.toml` sets `corpus_root = "evals"`, and `git grep -n 'docs/experiments' -- src docs scripts tests .github ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/archive' ':!docs/research' ':!docs/release-notes.md' ':!tests/fixtures' ':!tests/interfaces/contracts/test_removed_cli_verbs_heldout.py' ':!tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py' ':!tests/scripts/test_classify_gerrit_verify_change.py' ':!tests/unit/test_code_review_criteria_routing.py' ':!tests/unit/evals/test_evals_corpus_root.py' ':!tests/unit/test_packaging_dependencies.py'` prints nothing. The six test carve-outs are NOT missed repoints — each names the pre-move path for a reason that survives the move: two hold `_HISTORY_PREFIXES` scanning git HISTORY, where the old paths still exist in old commits; one holds synthetic classifier inputs that never referred to the tree; one asserts a value read from the frozen calibration document inside the moved tree, so it mirrors frozen data; one is an absence assertion, which has to spell out the string it forbids; and one documents, in prose, that the sdist shipped research READMEs from the old location before the move. Those carve-outs are HISTORICAL RECORDS, not misses: ADRs, archived session logs, research notes, release notes and frozen test fixtures record what the paths were when they were written, so repointing them would falsify the record. The moved tree's own 157 internal references are frozen for the same reason and sit outside this grep's scope. The top-level corpus is not shipped: after `python -m build`, `unzip -l dist/*.whl | awk '{print $4}' | grep -cE '^evals/'` prints `0` and `tar tzf dist/*.tar.gz | sed 's#^[^/]*/##' | grep -cE '^evals/'` prints `0` (both patterns are anchored to the archive root, so the shipped Python package `rebar/llm/evals/` does not match; `pyproject.toml:367` `packages = ["src/rebar"]` and `:398` sdist `include` already exclude a top-level `evals/`, so this check guards against a future include change). Checked by a repo-wide grep test and a packaging test. Delivered by the corpus-move story.
- [x] The client-facing harness docs exist: `docs/llm-framework.md` gains "Running the eval harnesses against your own criteria" (the commands, override precedence and output paths), and `docs/user-guide.md` gains a pointer section to it from the quality-gates chapter — the full content sits beside the extras taxonomy and LLM configuration it depends on, with discoverability from the user guide. `pip install nava-rebar[agents,evals]` is documented, and every key in `rebar._optional.EXTRAS` appears in the taxonomy (asserted by iterating EXTRAS, not a literal count — the prose said "three extras" while the registry held nine). The 71 orphaned fixture-drift tasks are closed `obsolete`; they were bulk-closed on 2026-09-08 with the reason "fixture-drift ticket mooted by ADR 0113 self-heal loop", NOT the wording this AC originally predicted, so the check is `rebar search "fixture-drift:" -o json | jq '[.[]|select(.ticket_type=="task" and .status!="closed")]|length'` printing `0` (the type filter is required: this epic's own child story matches the phrase). Checked by the docs gates in `make verify` and `tests/unit/test_llm_framework_docs.py`. Delivered by the client-documentation story.

## Child decomposition
- Config seam story (`disgusted-fretful-hare`, d279-4cf9-d1a6-4f7b): delivers criterion 1; plan-review certified.
- Corpus move story: delivers criterion 2; depends on the config seam.
- Client documentation story: delivers criterion 3; depends on the corpus move.
